title: Disappointment Aversion and Expectiles
abstract: arXiv:2508.05541v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper recasts Gul's (1991) theory of disappointment aversion in a Savage framework, with general outcomes, new explicit axioms of disappointment aversion, and novel explicit representations. These permit broader applications of the theory and a better understanding of its decision-theoretic foundations. Our results exploit an unexpected connection between Gul's model and the econometric framework of Newey and Powell (1987) of asymmetric least squares estimation. Our main axiomatization result shows that a preference relation over Savage acts is probabilistically sophisticated, invariant biseparable, and disappointment hedging if and only if it admits a representation \emph{\`a la} Gul, and hence all explicit equivalent representations that we present in the paper. We also derive a neurocomputational foundation of the theory based on recent neuroscience findings and a novel reinforcement learning result.

translated_title: 失望厌恶与期望分位数
translated_abstract: 本文在Savage框架下重新构建了Gul（1991）的失望厌恶理论，采用一般性结果、新的显式失望厌恶公理以及新颖的显式表示。这些使得该理论能够应用于更广泛的场景，并加深对其决策理论基础的理解。我们的结果利用了Gul模型与Newey和Powell（1987）的非对称最小二乘估计计量经济学框架之间的意外联系。我们的主要公理化结果表明，如果且仅如果Savage行为上的偏好关系是概率上精细的、不变双可分的，并且满足失望对冲性质，则它承认一种Gul风格的表示，因此也承认我们在论文中提出的所有显式等价表示。我们还基于近期神经科学发现和一个新颖的强化学习结果，推导了该理论的神经计算基础。
tldr: 本文在Savage框架下重新公理化Gul的失望厌恶理论，通过连接非对称最小二乘估计，提供显式表示和神经计算基础，拓宽了理论应用并深化了其决策基础理解。
en_tdlr: This paper reaxiomatizes Gul's disappointment aversion in a Savage framework, linking it to asymmetric least squares, providing explicit representations and a neurocomputational foundation, broadening applications and deepening decision-theoretic understanding.
